method_notes: Sweep of Equinix, Digital Realty, AirTrunk, Vantage, STACK, NTT, STT GDC, Keppel, CapitaLand, DayOne/GDS, ESR, PDG, Colt, ePLDT/VITRO, Globe/Innove, Converge, PLDT, Digital Edge, EdgeConneX, Microsoft, Google, AWS, Meta, Apple, Bitstop, SpaceDC, Beeinfotech, A-FLOW/FLOW/ALLHC, Evolution/Megawide, YCO Cloud.

Places swept: Makati, Taguig/BGC, Quezon City/Fairview, Pasig/Bridgetowne, Parañaque, Manila, Laguna (Sta. Rosa, Biñan, Laguna Technopark, LISP), Cavite (Silang/Gateway, General Trias hint), Clark/Pampanga, Cebu, Davao, Cainta/Rizal, Malvar/Batangas, Bataan, named PEZA parks.

Allowed SoR only: company IR/press/SEC/official DC; IFC disclosure; PEZA-adjacent park naming on company pages. Forbidden SoR (Baxtel, DataCenterMap, AIDCI, DC Byte, Wikipedia, consultant averages, news-only recaps) used as hints then verified or rejected.

Grain kept: IT capacity ≠ facility/utility/critical power ≠ interconnection ≠ generation/PPA. Equinix MN1/MN2/MN3 held (cabinet/IBX grain). Sub-250 disclosed pins stay (NARRA1 10, HIVE 20, A-FLOW 36, VSR 50).
Dry-run only. Do NOT publish to compute.world or GitHub. Fetch cache: /workspace/state/campus-hunt/philippines-fetch/.
